query:
SELECT DISTINCT FIRST_VALUE(date) OVER(
                PARTITION BY quest_id
                ORDER BY
                    CASE WHEN date IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
                    CASE WHEN complete = 1 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
                    date desc) AS "last_complete_date!: NaiveDate"
            FROM
                "dailies"
            WHERE
                quest_id = $1
            LIMIT 1;
